name: jarvis-core
description: Lokalny JARVIS: sprawy, ERP operacyjny, rozmowa i trwały Core ze zgodami i dowodami.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsx scripts/build-info.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts public web docs .github README.md AGENTS.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.web.json vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts public web docs .github README.md AGENTS.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.web.json vite.config.ts
